type Query = { isError: boolean; isLoading: boolean; data?: string[] };
export function project(heading: Query, details: Query) {
  if (heading.isLoading || details.isLoading) return { status: 'loading' };
  if (heading.isError || details.isError) return { status: 'error' };
  if (heading.data?.length === 0) return { status: 'empty' };
  return { status: 'ready' };
}
